scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap: install deps, start local Postgres (:5434), apply migrations. See docs/run-locally.md.
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate
scripts.//-- dev --: dev = frontend (:7777) + backend (:3001) in parallel. Needs dev:db:up first.
scripts.//-- db --: Local Postgres 17 in docker on :5434 (user/db water, app role water_app). Migrations live in backend/migrations.
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate
scripts.//-- build --: Production builds: static frontend (frontend/build) and the Lambda bundle (backend/dist/lambda.mjs).
scripts.//-- test --: test = unit tests everywhere (no DB). test:backend:db needs dev:db:up; it migrates and uses the water_test database.
